method: Applied complete landing.patch to a fresh isolated Git index based on first-batch HEAD, then rehashed all 66 resulting files and compared them to retained intent and working files.
scratch_rebuild_proof: Verified input patch hash and base HEAD fully reproduce the discarded isolated scratch tree.
prior_verifier_refusal: Initial preliminary verifier assumed expected_sha256; inspected serializer schema and used content_sha256. No false PASS emitted.
